extracted.intended_audience: policy researchers, stakeholders, and members of the public tracking Federal Register documents and preparing notice-and-comment responses about 'Build Back Better' programs and related rulemaking
extracted.subtask_description: A Federal Register search-results/listing page showing metadata and excerpts for documents matching the query 'Build Back Better' (notices, rules, presidential documents, meetings, etc.). The page aggregates many agency entries and short excerpts rather than a single cohesive guidance document.

rubrics_metrics.name: 60-day public comment period for PRA submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: "The purpose of this notice is to allow for 60 days of public comment preceding submission of the collection to OMB."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) information-collection notices routinely provide a 60-day public comment window prior to OMB submission; agencies must solicit public and interagency comment during this period.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRA information-collection burden elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices describe and quantify burden elements: "Estimated Number of Respondents and Frequency", "Estimated Average Hours per Response", and "Estimated Burden Hours" (e.g., "A total of 21 coalitions...quarterly...2.5 hours per respondent/per quarter...Estimated Burden Hours: 210.").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information-collection notices must provide estimated respondent counts, reporting frequency, average hours per response, and total burden hours, and include a 'Needs and Uses' statement explaining data purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mixed-methods approach for program monitoring and evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: "The proposed information collection employs a mixed methods approach to gather traditional metrics in addition to qualitative data on all regions participating in the Build Back Better Regional Challenge. Secondary data will be gathered and monitored for each of the regions/awardees. A quarterly questionnaire is sent to each of the BBBRC..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program monitoring/assessment should combine quantitative (traditional metrics, secondary data) and qualitative information (surveys, interviews), with periodic (e.g., quarterly) reporting to capture performance over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comments may inform future agency actions
rubrics_metrics.description: "Responses may be used to inform ICIC's future actions to improve the operations and delivery of federal community investment programs through stronger federal collaboration."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Solicited public responses (RFI/RFA/comments) can be used by agencies to shape future program design, operations, and interagency collaboration; commenters should be aware their input may influence policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agencies may extend comment periods to allow additional time
rubrics_metrics.description: "The purpose of this notice is to extend the comment period for a period of two weeks until December 19, 2022 as to provide more time for interested parties to submit comments."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies can and do extend comment deadlines when needed; extensions are issued via notices and should be monitored by stakeholders preparing submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advisory committee role and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: "The purpose of the Committee is to advise the Secretary of Agriculture on State and Federal meat and poultry inspection programs, food safety, and other matters...will convene virtually...to offer input on ways FSIS can enhance outreach efforts to best promote equity and bring economic opportunity to underserved communities..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal advisory committees provide targeted advice to agency leadership, shape outreach and equity strategies, and their public meetings solicit stakeholder input; committee charges define the scope of input sought.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rebuild activities must respect community preferences and cultural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: From a Presidential document: "Throughout these efforts, we remain focused on rebuilding the way the people of Maui want to build by respecting sacred lands, cultures, and traditions."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reconstruction/recovery policies should center community preferences and protect sacred lands, cultural practices, and traditions when planning and implementing rebuilding efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program investments should promote high labor, environmental, social, and technical standards
rubrics_metrics.description: "My Administration's Build Back Better World initiative will play an important role ... promoting the highest labor, environmental, social, and technical standards."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal and international development initiatives tied to 'Build Back Better' emphasize elevating labor protections, environmental safeguards, social standards, and technical quality in funded projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRA notices must invite the general public and other Federal agencies to comment
rubrics_metrics.description: "The Department of Commerce, in accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA), invites the general public and other Federal agencies to comment on proposed, and continuing information collections..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When collecting information under PRA, agencies must publish notices inviting both public and interagency comment and describe the purpose and expected burden of the collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rulemakings should include cost-benefit/cost-impact statements
rubrics_metrics.description: From a final rule: "This final rule does not impose any new costs to industry or the Government by amending... Cost Savings—Electronic..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rulemaking publications commonly include a cost-benefit or cost-impact analysis describing quantified costs and any cost savings relative to the baseline; these statements inform stakeholders of economic effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules and orders must state effective dates and any corrective clarifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Example language: "DATES: Effective January 9, 2026." and "This document also makes a clarifying correction to one ACF rule to better reflect its purpose..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final rules and clarifying documents should specify an effective date and explicitly identify any corrections or clarifications to prior text so regulated parties know compliance timing and obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public meetings gather stakeholder input and may have accessibility limits (e.g., not live streamed)
rubrics_metrics.description: NHTSA: "NHTSA intends to gather specific input on potential actions... The event will not be live streamed."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies use public meetings to solicit stakeholder views that inform guidance; logistics (in-person vs. virtual, streaming availability) affect accessibility and stakeholder participation.
